stash_browse.description:
IDENTITY: this is the stash — a structured cross-session cache. Use it for data you need to survive between sessions but that is disposable: job state, a rate-limit counter, a work-in-progress draft, dedup markers. It is NOT memory: anything worth remembering — a fact, a decision, a preference, a rule — belongs in the memory tools' write, not here. Entries expire (TTL) and can be evicted under the size budget (least-recently-accessed first); never rely on a stash entry surviving indefinitely.

Browse the stash as an inspection panel: namespace, key, size, and expiry — never the stored value itself (this is for seeing what is cached and how big it is, not for reading it; use stash_get for that). Call with no namespace for the overview of every namespace and its entry count; pass one of those namespaces back in to see its entries.

namespace.description: Drill into this namespace's entries, or leave unset for the namespace overview.

Read a value by namespace/key. Bumps the entry's last-accessed time (relevant to LRU eviction). Hard-expired entries read as not found; entries past their stale_after_seconds are still returned with stale=true.

key.description: The entry's key within its namespace.

namespace.description: The cache namespace this key lives in.

stash_set.description:
IDENTITY: this is the stash — a structured cross-session cache. Use it for data you need to survive between sessions but that is disposable: job state, a rate-limit counter, a work-in-progress draft, dedup markers. Write a value into the stash under namespace/key. Optional ttl_seconds is the hard expiry; optional stale_after_seconds marks the entry stale (still returned by stash_get, flagged) before that. Overwrites any existing value at the same key.

key.description: The entry's key within its namespace.

namespace.description: The cache namespace this key lives in.

stale_after_seconds.description: Seconds from now after which the entry is marked stale.

ttl_seconds.description: Hard expiry in seconds from now. None = no expiry.
